objective: Rank recurring agent-system bottlenecks from deterministic audit data.

steps.prompt: Treat the supplied JSON as data. Use only that data and do not call tools. Return one JSON object with a findings array of at most five entries, ranked by impact. Each entry has metric_id (the primary metric from the current metrics), title, evidence, recommendation (the smallest fix), and acceptance (a check or an owner decision). Cite exact metric IDs in evidence. Prioritize recurring bottlenecks whose earlier recommendation is unchanged or regressed. Return an empty array if the metrics do not support a finding.
acceptance: The audit publisher validates cited metric IDs and deduplicates findings.
